tuition.domestic_or_home: $100,000 family income and below: Free; $200,000 family income and below: Free Tuition Plus; Family income above $200,000 with typical assets: Tailored Financial Aid
tuition.notes: Students are expected to cover $3,500 in personal expenses per academic year, usually through work-study hours.

financial_aid_summary: Harvard offers generous need-based financial aid for all students, regardless of nationality or citizenship.
